worldcombat.skill.dracometeor.summary: Calls comets straight down onto their impact points: each deals special damage once to every foe in its impact radius and scorches that ground for a while, a foe that leaves the point dodges it, and the barrage form's overlapping circles can catch the same foe several times. The summon immediately costs the user a harsh Sp. Atk drop.
worldcombat.skill.dracometeor.use.1: Barrage form: scatter impacts over a clustered group
worldcombat.skill.dracometeor.use.2: Scorch the ground around the impact points
worldcombat.skill.dracometeor.descriptio: Calls down comets; each falls straight onto its impact point, dealing about %1$s special damage to every foe within the impact radius.
Range %1$s blocks; comets fall straight down at %2$s blocks/tick from %4$s blocks up, with an impact radius of %3$s blocks.
Each impact scorches the ground within %1$s blocks, restoring it after about %2$s.
After the summon the user's Sp. Atk drops %1$s stage(s), hit or miss.
worldcombat.skill.dracometeor.barrage.on: Barrage form: calls %1$s comets scattered within %2$s blocks, one every %3$s s; each deals x0.8 power, their impact circles can overlap and one foe may be hit by several.
worldcombat.skill.dracometeor.barrage.of: Single form: one big comet drops straight onto the target, heavier and faster, but only hits one point.
worldcombat.skill.dracometeor.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.dracometeor.growth.0: From level %1$s the meteor power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.dracometeor.growth.1: From level %1$s the meteor power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.dracometeor.preference: On: calls several comets scattered around the target, each at x0.8 power, wind-up +5 ticks, cooldown +8 ticks; better against groups. Off (single): one big comet drops straight onto the target, heavier, faster, but only one point.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger starts the summon from farther away.
On: targets with more foes around them rank higher, so the barrage covers the group; off: ordinary ranged ordering.
Below this distance to the target Draco Meteor ranks lower (0 = no limit). Higher makes it save the move until it has opened the range.
worldcombat.skill.dracometeor.descriptio: The first comet aims where the target is at that moment; a comet that grazes a foe on the way down bursts on it, otherwise it bursts on the ground, so a foe that steps out of the impact radius dodges it.
